code.text: """The synthetic application verified and published by Unspool CI."""

def profile(record):
    public = {field: record[field] for field in PUBLIC_FIELDS}
    display_name = public["display_name"].replace(ZERO_WIDTH_SPACE, " ")
    display_name = " ".join(display_name.split())
    # Legacy profiles may have no display name; fall back to the customer handle.
    public["display_name"] = display_name or public["customer_id"]
    return public
